name: background-summary-taken-by-compact
about: Web search on, build tools off, COMPACT_BACKGROUND_AT 0.2: after the second turn the history is past it and there is no tool output to trim, so the summary a compaction would need is written in the background (a non-streamed request with the tools in the prompt and calls forbidden); /compact then takes it instead of a model pass of its own, and the third turn goes out after it.
